arguments.sql: SELECT c.has_chip, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id GROUP BY c.has_chip ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC, c.has_chip
arguments.explanation: Shows the fraud rate for cards with a chip and cards without one, in place of the card-brand breakdown. Only transactions that have a fraud label are counted.
assumptions: "Instead" means grouping by has_chip only (1 = has a chip, 0 = no chip), not by card brand and chip together.
